DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Hepatitis B superimposed on chronic Hepatitis B infection.

The combination of significantly elevated transaminases (AST/ALT), jaundice indicators, and the specific serology pattern (HBsAg+, HBcAb+, HBsAg+, Anti-HBc IgG+) confirms an active Hepatitis B flare, likely triggered by the recent exposure at the state fair or reactivation of a chronic infection.
